description: Phase 1.1 alignment eval: process-behavior cases (machine-checkable against the SKILL.md contract) plus a 20-item trigger / near-miss description set for triggering accuracy.

evals.name: new-task-auto-enters-alignment
evals.prompt: I just ran workloom_task_create for 'add offline caching to the mobile client'. The task is in planning and the prd.md is still the skeleton. Take the alignment from here.
evals.expected_output: The skill starts the Phase 1.1 design tree from the Goal/value node, keeps each round to the full current frontier as one numbered batch with a recommendation per decision node, writes settled conclusions into prd.md incrementally, and never asks a 'do you need grilling?' question.
assertions: opens from Goal and value without asking whether grilling is needed
lists the whole frontier in one round instead of one question at a time
gives a recommendation with reasoning for each decision node
never loads brainstorm/ui-design/grilling fixed questions

evals.name: ui-applicability-consults-reference
evals.prompt: We are aligning a workloom task that rebuilds the settings screen with a new layout, empty/error states and light/dark theming. Settle the UI applicability node.
evals.expected_output: The alignment marks frontend UI presentation as applicable, reads references/ui-design, walks the seven axes until decidable, and records a ## UI Design section in prd.md.
assertions: loads the UI axes reference (references/ui-design) on the applicability node
covers the seven UI axes or explicitly marks not applicable
records decidable UI requirements in the prd.md ## UI Design section
keeps the UI work as design-tree nodes rather than a separate 1.1b phase

evals.name: test-first-seam-confirmation
evals.prompt: Aligning a workloom task for a payments retry service that clearly needs tests before implementation. Resolve the test-first node and close the loop.
evals.expected_output: The alignment consults references/test-first, asks the applicability question (yes/no/critical paths only), confirms the seams with the user, and writes the confirmed seams into prd.md acceptance criteria.
assertions: asks the test-first applicability question with the three options
consults the test-first reference and confirms the seams before prd.md finalization
records the confirmed seams in acceptance criteria
leaves the red-green method itself to the generic tdd skill in Phase 2.1

evals.name: prd-changed-after-confirm-stale-reentry
evals.prompt: The prd.md of an aligned workloom task changed after workloom_task_align confirm (a new platform target appeared). The start tool now refuses with a stale message. Handle it.
evals.expected_output: The skill re-enters alignment focused on the changed area first, then recomputes the full frontier, and re-runs review → user confirmation → confirm so the credential matches again.
assertions: first re-opens only the area affected by the change
then recomputes the full frontier before claiming convergence
runs workloom_task_align review then confirm with the fresh hash
does not silently reuse the old credential

evals.name: fixed-convergence-order-review-confirm
evals.prompt: The frontier of the active workloom alignment is empty and prd.md is complete with the ## Alignment Decisions section. Take it through convergence.
evals.expected_output: The alignment follows the fixed order: frontier empty → finalize prd → workloom_task_align action=review (snapshot + hash shown) → user explicitly confirms → action=confirm with expectedPrdHash and a summary; same-hash repeat is idempotent.
assertions: runs action=review before any confirm
shows the snapshot and hash to the user before confirm
sets the <!-- workloom:open-nodes=none --> marker before confirming
writes the credential only after explicit user confirmation

evals.name: grill-request-inside-workloom-routes-here
evals.prompt: While in an active workloom planning task the user says: 'grill this requirement set before we write design.md'.
evals.expected_output: The request routes to workloom-alignment: design-tree rounds with recommendations inside the Phase 1.1 alignment, not to the generic grilling skill.
assertions: treats the request as a design-tree round inside Phase 1.1
does not hand off to a separate generic grilling session
keeps the pressure test inside the same prd.md / Alignment Decisions record
